detail: 82.6 million readings in a 10.3 GB CSV: the loader parses it in 39 minutes at a 112 GB peak, and every merge and admission loads it. The hand check of #162 found it grouped by Loader ID, the upload log a reading came in.

1,648,512 persons in 286 columns, the first half of the ACS 2018 national person file: each of its three models takes the registry's measurement about half an hour, on every merge. The hand check of #162 found it grouped by state, PUMA and household (SERIALNO).
